SCI-FRUIT v0.1/r0.2 — INTERIM TARGETED CORE CORRECTION

The current in-progress r0.2 common-core direction is accepted.

Continue the existing r0.2 task. Do not restart Stage B and do not perform
another broad derivation.

Preserve:

- the exact candidate/accepted/applied model distinction;
- the applied model as the removal and rejoin operand;
- additive/reference/gauge/null-space compatibility;
- the conditional remove -> process -> rejoin composition;
- the fixed-linear hierarchy and D_k only under complete linearity;
- strict fixed-numerical RF-01/RF-02 conditioning;
- prescribed recomputation in RF-03 unless an induced-fixed-map proof exists;
- the general differentiable fixed-state response;
- RF-03 through RF-07 causal scopes;
- complete parent/applied-model covariance with both cross terms;
- full-product versus zero-target-center member action;
- all eight support/influence roles;
- the seven operation-state categories;
- immutable original-parent ancestry;
- continuation, restart, retry, completion, and terminal selection distinctions;
- terminal-candidate comparability;
- local completion separate from downstream use;
- no numerical method or route;
- every existing claim ceiling and nonclaim.

Apply the following corrections before authoring the final requirements,
predictions, rationale, ECS, manifests, or PDFs.

======================================================================
1. MAKE CONDITIONING RELATIVE TO THE DECLARED STOCHASTIC LAW
======================================================================

The current Omega_(k,pre)^FRUIT wording is too universal.

Define every stochastic target by:

    target_law_identity
    random_variables
    conditioned_fixed_objects
    resolution_or_selection_condition
    omitted_variation
    support/domain
    reference/gauge/null-space state.

“Pre-outcome” means fixed before the random event of that exact target law.

Distinguish at least:

A. physical/random-parent target

The measured parent and any model whose variation is being estimated remain
random. Do not condition on their realized numerical values.

B. fixed-realized-model target

The exact applied model is conditioned fixed. Model covariance and parent-model
cross terms vanish only within this narrower target. Model-learning variation
remains omitted.

C. conditional NOI-randomization target

The realized parent payload, fixed applied model, fixed operator graph, support,
and other declared state may be conditioning facts because they exist before
the NOI assignment/member is drawn.

This is not the physical-parent stochastic target.

Where the exact NOI source law is conditional on successful design resolution,
record that conditioning explicitly. Do not hide it in a generic generation
label, and do not prohibit it as though every form of outcome conditioning were
the same scientific target.

A branch-, completion-, convergence-, or terminal-selection-conditioned FRUIT
target would require a separate method and estimand. It remains unavailable
unless separately authorized; it is not silently represented by
Omega_(k,pre)^FRUIT.

Update the covariance definition, NOI boundary, assumptions, requirements,
predictions, method record, and ECS fixtures.

======================================================================
2. TYPE THE NOI MEMBER AS A ZERO-TARGET-LAW OBJECT
======================================================================

Do not use “centered perturbation” in a way that implies member-wise,
map-wise, or finite-ensemble mean subtraction.

Define the relevant object as a member/random variable whose expectation under
the exact declared NOI target law is zero.

Use a law-qualified expectation, for example:

    E_D[delta y_(k,b)^NOI | exact fixed parent, model, operator and design
        conditioning] = 0.

Retain explicitly:

- the zero is a target-law expectation;
- no individual member is required to have zero sample or spatial mean;
- no finite-ensemble mean subtraction is implied;
- no B-1 correction is implied;
- source and deterministic residual structure may remain in individual members.

For a zero-target-law member under the complete fixed-linear premises:

    delta z_(k,b)^NOI
      =
      A_k delta y_(k,b)^NOI.

Do not add D_k m_k^applied to each such member.

For a full parent realization:

    z_(k,b)^full
      =
      A_k y_(k,b)^full
      +
      D_k m_k^applied.

A full-affine-member method requires its own center and estimator authority.

Bind the exact external NOI authority or owner-directive source identity.
Replace the temporal phrase “current ordinary SCI-NOI ensemble” with one exact
source-bound target-law identity or a typed unavailable external binding.

This conditional equation does not admit a numerical FRUIT/NOI route.

======================================================================
3. REPAIR THE LOCAL LIFECYCLE BRANCHING
======================================================================

Remove:

    not_requested -> requested.

Use:

    request_state:
        not_requested | requested.

For one immutable requested generation, the successful producer-stage order is:

    requested
      ->
    effective
      ->
    application_scope_resolved
      ->
    applied
      ->
    iteration_realized
      ->
    complete_iteration_candidate
      ->
    completion_decided
      ->
    completed_iteration
      ->
    published.

A later change from not_requested to requested creates a new request
generation.

Keep separately typed:

    scientific availability:
        available | unavailable;

    producer outcome:
        realized | failed | not_produced

or exact library-compatible equivalents.

Unavailable, failed, and not_produced are branch/role outcomes at the stage
actually reached. They are not mandatory steps on the successful path.

Do not fabricate applied, realized, completion, or publication records after an
earlier stop.

An unavailable optional companion may coexist with a narrower complete product
only when both the core and exact method permit it.

Update product definitions, method record, REQ-017--021 as applicable,
predictions, ECS records, and all diagrams.

======================================================================
4. SEPARATE TRANSFER, OUTPUT SHIFT, BIAS, AND UNCERTAINTY
======================================================================

Choose exact canonical identities.

Use:

    D_k
      = model-path transfer operator;

    Delta z_k^model
      = model-induced output shift
      = D_k delta m_k^applied;

    b_(z,k)^model
      = model-induced bias

only when the target estimand, reference/truth model, model-error random
variable, probability law, and conditioning exist.

Do not describe Delta z_k^model interchangeably as both
model_error_transfer and model_induced_output_shift.

Do not combine model mismatch and bias into one
“model-mismatch/bias” uncertainty role.

Create independently addressable roles, provisionally:

    SCI-FRUIT/MODEL-PATH-TRANSFER
    SCI-FRUIT/MODEL-INDUCED-OUTPUT-SHIFT
    SCI-FRUIT/MODEL-INDUCED-BIAS.

A deterministic model difference or output shift is not covariance.
A computable output shift does not establish bias.
Bias may be unavailable while the transfer and shift are available.

Transform accepted-model error through the exact
acceptance-to-application relation before it enters the applied-model shift.

======================================================================
5. MAKE r0.2 THE COMPLETE SOLE ACTIVE CORE
======================================================================

The final core shall not rely on:

    all other inherited r0.1 constraints remain

as hidden normative authority.

Use:

    The r0.1 architecture was accepted as the revision basis.
    The r0.1 artifacts are historical input and comparison evidence.
    SCI-FRUIT-NORMATIVE-CORE v0.1/r0.2 is the complete sole active Stage B
    scientific authority and supersedes r0.1.
    Every surviving obligation is restated here or imported through one exact
    explicitly named content-bound source.

Return an exact r0.1-to-r0.2 semantic and identity crosswalk covering:

- all 24 requirements;
- all six assumptions;
- all 20 predictions;
- product roles;
- lifecycle states;
- response roles;
- uncertainty roles;
- edge cases;
- nonclaims.

No unstated r0.1 sentence remains active.

Bind the exact Stage A packet, owner approval/freeze, r0.2 directive, common
core, document sources, and build record by identities and SHA-256 values.

======================================================================
6. ENUMERATE EXACT PRODUCT-ROLE FAMILIES
======================================================================

Do not leave these as unexplained placeholder identities:

    SCI-FRUIT/RESPONSE/<RF-role>
    SCI-FRUIT/UNCERTAINTY/<role>.

Either enumerate every exact role or define a formal registered family grammar.

At minimum bind exact response identities for RF-01 through RF-07.

Enumerate separately available uncertainty roles, including:

- measured-parent covariance;
- candidate-model uncertainty;
- candidate-selection uncertainty;
- accepted-model covariance;
- acceptance-to-application transformation uncertainty;
- applied-model covariance;
- measured-parent/applied-model cross covariance;
- operator/state uncertainty;
- support/threshold-selection uncertainty;
- stopping/terminal-selection uncertainty;
- external-prior uncertainty;
- empirical repeatability;
- exact NOI-owned product identity.

Do not put model-induced output shift or bias into that family by implication.

State explicitly:

    SCI-FRUIT/ITERATION-RESULT is a child numerical payload.
    A bare z_k is not a scientifically complete FRUIT handoff.
    Scientific consumption requires the exact ITERATION-BUNDLE or an immutable
    exact reference to it.

======================================================================
7. MAKE TERMINAL USE REFERENCES SCI-VAL-CONGRUENT AND OPEN-WORLD
======================================================================

Terminal field 9 shall contain only explicitly requested or linked downstream
decision records.

Do not require an exhaustive closed-world list of all future uses.

For a SCI-VAL-governed use, retain exact:

    request
    applicability
    eligibility
    realization

states and the exact profile/source binding.

Do not use generic unavailable as a SCI-VAL realization value.

A not-requested use creates no eligibility proposition.
A missing profile or unresolved scope may produce a realized accounting record
with applicability_unknown and decision_unavailable.
An incomplete, failed, or not-produced decision artifact is a separate
realization condition.

Use wording equivalent to:

    requested linked named-use decision identities and exact statuses,
    or an explicit statement that no downstream use was requested.

No downstream decision participates in base iteration or terminal completion
unless the exact requested FRUIT product role explicitly requires that child.

======================================================================
8. USE COLLISION-FREE NOI NOTATION
======================================================================

Replace unqualified Y_b and Z_b with iteration- and role-qualified symbols, for
example:

    y_(k,b)^full
    z_(k,b)^full
    delta y_(k,b)^NOI
    delta z_(k,b)^NOI.

Bind:

- iteration;
- member;
- target law;
- parent domain;
- output domain;
- ensemble generation;
- center convention.

Use E_D or another exact target-law-qualified expectation rather than one
unqualified expectation symbol when discussing the NOI design law.

Do not collide with PTC transformed-signal notation or the FRUIT result-space
symbol Z_k.

======================================================================
9. COMPLETE THE REMAINING r0.2 ARTIFACTS
======================================================================

After these corrections, complete:

- normative requirements SCI-FRUIT-REQ-001--024;
- assumptions SCI-FRUIT-ASM-001--006;
- predictions SCI-FRUIT-PRED-001--020;
- typed edge and unavailable behavior;
- concise scientific rationale;
- actual Engineering Conformance Specification;
- source, owner, build, and parity records;
- manifests and sidecars;
- PDFs and visual QA.

Preserve IDs when the obligation is being clarified. Add a new ID only for a
genuinely new independent obligation.

The ECS result vocabulary shall be exact, preferably:

    pass
    fail
    blocked
    not_applicable
    not_assessed.

Evidence-artifact realization shall remain separately typed.

The rationale shall explain the core without reproducing the requirement,
prediction, method-template, or engineering-evidence registers.

The ECS shall contain evidence procedure rather than reproduce the scientific
rationale.

No numerical method, route, implementation conformance, response/covariance
fidelity, uncertainty coverage, recovered measured mode, convergence adequacy,
Pointing/OOF/catalogue fitness, observational validation, performance,
readiness, production suitability, production authorization, or Unity activity
is established.
